Keyboard shortcuts

Shortcuts use the key's position, so they work the same with an Arabic keyboard layout.

General
Keys	Action
Alt
L
	Switch language

Ctrl
K
	Open the command palette

?
	Show keyboard shortcuts

Ctrl
/
	Show keyboard shortcuts

Alt
P
	Open my preferences
Navigation
Keys	Action
Alt
M
	Move to the navigation pane

Alt
H
	Go to the home screen

Alt
B
	Show or hide the navigation pane

↑
↓
	Move between navigation entries

Home
End
	First or last navigation entry

Tab
	Skip to the screen's content (first Tab)
